scenes.title: Local Bench
scenes.caption: Benchmark the models you actually run.
scenes.narration: This is Local Bench, from Companion Intelligence.

scenes.caption: One page. No account, no telemetry, no cloud.
scenes.narration: One page. The curated catalog, what Ollama has installed, and its smartest model.

shots.alt: Local Bench dashboard: hero copy and four summary cards for catalog size, installed models, top intelligence score and fastest measured model.

scenes.caption: Forty-two curated models. Ollama serves them.
scenes.narration: Local Bench talks to Ollama. With no daemon running, it shows the catalog and says so.

shots.alt: The model picker: curated Ollama models as selectable cards, the installed and curated counts, and the notice that Ollama is not reachable.

scenes.caption: Start the daemon. What you have pulled unlocks.
scenes.narration: Start Ollama and the catalog comes alive. Anything you have already pulled becomes selectable.

shots.alt: The model picker with Ollama connected: the installed catalog models sort to the top with enabled checkboxes, above the disabled cards for models not pulled locally.

before.eval: (() => { const bar = document.querySelector('.topbar').getBoundingClientRect().height; const label = document.getElementById('modelList').previousElementSibling; window.scrollTo(0, label.getBoundingClientRect().top + window.scrollY - bar - 14); })()

scenes.caption: Pick a prompt. Edit it. That exact text runs.
scenes.narration: Pick a prompt. The box below it is editable, and that exact text is what runs.

shots.alt: The test prompt dropdown, its category and description, and the editable textarea holding the prompt that will be sent to the model.

scenes.caption: Fourteen prompts, each tagged with the work it tests.
scenes.narration: Fourteen prompts, from coding to operations. Expand one to read it first.

shots.alt: The prompt library grid with the first card expanded to reveal the full prompt text that will be sent to the model.

before.eval: (() => { const bar = document.querySelector('.topbar').getBoundingClientRect().height; const label = document.getElementById('promptLibrary').previousElementSibling; window.scrollTo(0, label.getBoundingClientRect().top + window.scrollY - bar - 14); })()

scenes.caption: Select what you have installed, then run.
scenes.narration: Select what you have installed and run it. Models you have not pulled stay disabled.

shots.alt: The run controls — Run benchmark, Select all installed, Clear selection — sitting under the prompt library.

scenes.caption: The run finishes on your machine. Nothing metered.
scenes.narration: The run finishes on your own machine. Nothing was uploaded, and nothing was metered.

shots.alt: A completed benchmark: the success notice counting the successful runs, above the model cards for the two models that were selected and measured.

scenes.caption: Every run records the hardware behind it.
scenes.narration: Every run records the hardware it ran on: processor, memory, and graphics.

shots.alt: The System specifications card: server name, CPU model, core and thread counts, memory, operating system, motherboard and detected GPU.

scenes.caption: Speed is half the question. Read the answers.
scenes.narration: Speed is only half the question. Read what each model actually wrote.

shots.alt: The Response comparison section: the prompt that was sent, then two model pickers with each model's full answer in its own pane.

before.eval: (() => { const bar = document.querySelector('.topbar').getBoundingClientRect().height; const el = document.getElementById('responseSection'); window.scrollTo(0, el.getBoundingClientRect().top + window.scrollY - bar); })()

scenes.caption: Ranked by intelligence index, before you download.
scenes.narration: Thirty-one rated models, ranked by the Artificial Analysis intelligence index.

shots.alt: The Model intelligence table: the rated catalog models ranked by intelligence index, each with its score, size, context window and input types.

scenes.caption: The docs ship inside the app.
scenes.narration: The docs ship inside the app: what the numbers mean, how to budget agents.

shots.alt: The in-app documentation view: the topic list beside the Local Bench overview topic.

scenes.title: Local Bench
scenes.caption: Measured on your hardware, stored on your disk.
scenes.narration: Forty-two models, fourteen prompts, results in a local SQLite file.
Local Bench. Companion Intelligence. UnCloud your life.
